body: New socket ask "rows" answers {lines, solid} (solid = rows with SGR 2 cells as spaces); an old cctg run answers nothing to it and term::rows falls back to "screen" with solid None. Rejected: changing the "screen" answer shape (breaks old agents/runs) and caching the fallback per Run.

Ghost = SGR 2 only (placeholder, prompt suggestion, inline completion per bundle and conpty bytes); the grey argument hint (theme inactive rgb 153) is not treated as ghost. Alternative rejected: any grey foreground, which risks hiding a real draft drawn in a theme grey.
Windows: ReadConsoleOutputW attribute words cannot tell the faint placeholder from typed text (both 0x0007); Windows keeps the text-only box check (Rows.solid None).

Verdict NEEDS_WORK over SHIP: wrap joining fixes the live refusal, but the faint filter assumes the whole inline completion is SGR 2 while Cursor.render draws its first grapheme solid (repro: non-space suffix still Draft); tests and FINDINGS claim coverage. Alternative considered: SHIP with a known-limit note, rejected because the claim is baked into tests.

Ghost text judged in keys::typed_box from the existing cell-aligned solid rows (only the trailing faint run is dropped; any faint cell before solid text disables the filter) instead of changing the rows answer of cctg run. Alternative rejected: a per-cell faint map or cursor position in Rows, more wire surface for no case the aligned solid rows cannot tell.

Completion rule counts one char (not a full grapheme; unicode-segmentation is transcript-only) before the trailing faint run, with a non-whitespace char before it on the same row; multi-code-point first graphemes and a first grapheme at a wrapped row start refuse. Alternative rejected: accepting any text+one-extra with faint somewhere after it (review suggestion verbatim), which accepts a user char followed by unrelated faint text.
